description.value: The study investigated common and differential neural alterations in general emotion processing in OCD and SAD using fMRI during cued anticipation and perception of unspecific emotional stimuli.

spans.text: The goal of this study was to examine similar/common and differential neurobiological responses in OCD and SAD using unspecific emotional stimuli.

value: Emotion processing circuits (e.g. amygdala and insula) in the combined OCD-SAD patient group will be hyper-reactive compared to HCs.

OCD patients would show hyper-reactivity in the striatum, caudate, VMPFC and OFC compared to SAD patients, and SAD patients would show stronger activations in amygdala, and DLPFC compared to OCD patients.

description.value: Fifty-four subjects participated: two patient groups and one healthy-control group; the groups were compared cross-sectionally.
